issue.title: Replace stale Gemini 3.7 Flash pins in reads macro and SASE examples
issue.description: Proposing bead: sase-1ss.1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #4 (SASE half). Confirmed on cf7a09f15b: sase/macros/reads.md:45 explicitly invokes agy/gemini-3.7-flash-high and tests/test_macro_swarm_local_helpers.py:111 pins it. docs/reference/macros/directive-syntax.md:34, config examples, src/sase/default_config.yml:355 and src/sase/config/sase.schema.json:4013 carry the same obsolete model. Current agy 1.5.8 models omits every 3.7 Flash variant, and the accepted research documents its invalid-model launch error. Update operational pins and current examples to an accessible fixed-effort slug, using gemini-3.8-flash-high for the conservative equivalent unless the example intentionally demonstrates Hydrogen. Update the matching macro assertion; regenerate config docs through the normal renderer. Do not remove historical changelog text or catalogued Enterprise-only rows in this task: catalog policy belongs to sase-1l4. Read macros/docs memory before edits, then just fix and sase tool run check. The separate chezmoi task handles home snippets and tmux. Small because the root cause is a finite set of literal pins with no backend behavior change.

task_type_fields.impact: The reads helper and copied examples fail to launch agy on non-Enterprise accounts.
task_type_fields.repro: Compare agy models on 1.5.8 with rg -n gemini-3.7-flash-high sase/macros/reads.md tests/test_macro_swarm_local_helpers.py docs/reference/macros/directive-syntax.md src/sase/default_config.yml src/sase/config/sase.schema.json. Explicit macro pins still select a missing model despite repaired provider tiers.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1ss.1 note #4; hard-coded selectors bypass the repaired provider tiers and continue choosing a model absent from the current account catalogue.
